title: Shift summaries and incident quick-links: console prototype for on-call handoffs
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Problem: On-call engineers and rotations lack a concise, actionable snapshot at shift change. Current handoffs happen via chat threads and ad-hoc links to alerts and postmortems; we see repeated friction where incoming on-callers spend 10–25 minutes rebuilding context (open alerts, recent deploy rollouts, SLO hits, and related runbooks).

Goal: Design a lightweight, scannable 'Shift Summary' card in the Console that appears for on-call users at the start of a shift and is accessible from Team > On-call. The card should bundle: 1) active alerts with priority and last-update, 2) recent SLO breaches and trending metrics, 3) latest deployment rollouts that touched alerting services, 4) direct links to the live incident, runbook, and postmortem draft, and 5) an explicit 'handoff note' field for the previous shift to leave one-line context.

Constraints: Must be implementable with existing Console APIs (alerts feed, SLO service endpoints, rollout metadata), minimal additional backend work (ENG-6221 provides endpoint for aggregated context), and should respect RBAC and PII constraints (no sensitive logs in preview). Accessibility: ensure high-contrast labels, keyboard focus for quick link list, and aria-live region for live alert count.

Design deliverables requested in this ticket:
- Low-fidelity wireframes for Shift Summary card and expanded Incident Quick-Links drawer.
- Clickable Figma prototype showing handoff flow (previous shift adds note, new on-caller reads and acknowledges).
- Microcopy for cards, acknowledgement CTA, and 'Create Postmortem' quick action.
- Acceptance criteria and handoff to ENG for implementation with a focused scope for minimal backend changes.

Why this is important: reduces time-to-ownership at shift start, improves post-incident follow-up velocity, and lowers duplication of effort. Metric targets: reduce average time-to-first-action by 30% during handoffs and increase postmortem creation within 48 hours by 20% for incidents surfaced via Shift Summary.
acceptance_criteria: Shift Summary card renders in Team > On-call for users assigned to current rotation
Card surfaces up to 5 active alerts with severity, time-since-update, and direct link to alert page
SLO section shows last 24h breaches with trend sparkline and link to SLO detail
Rollout section lists recent deploys (last 6 hours) affecting services in the on-call roster
Handoff note supports rich text up to 500 chars and a required short summary when acknowledging shift
Clicking 'Create Postmortem' pre-populates a template and links draft to the incident/alert
Accessibility: keyboard navigation and screen-reader labels implemented for all interactive elements
comments: 2025-02-18 Maya Patel: Initial problem statement and wireframes uploaded. Focused on minimal backend dependency—ENG-6221 should expose aggregated context endpoint. Requesting early engineering feasibility check.

2025-02-20 Liam O'Connor: Did an engineering pass — ENG-6221 can return alerts+SLO links but rollout metadata needs small addition (deploy tags). Proposed scope: MVP without deploy tags; add later in a follow-up. Marking estimate 3pt.

2025-02-21 Priya Singh (PM): Good approach. Please ensure the 'Create Postmortem' action respects project templates and sets owner to on-call user by default. Add an analytics event 'shift_summary_ack' for measurement.

2025-02-24 Accessibility review (Jonas Reed): Use aria-live for alert count changes and ensure the handoff note textarea has label and 1:1 contrast for placeholder text. Recommend 12px min hit target for quick-links in dense lists.

2025-02-26 Design review (Maya Patel, Liam O'Connor, Priya Singh): Decided on a collapsed default card that expands on click to avoid dashboard clutter. Keep 'Acknowledge shift' as a soft action that posts to incident timeline if an alert is acknowledged.

2025-03-01 Engineering sync (ENG-6221 owner): Implemented backend change to include recent rollouts. Feature flag 'shift-summary-v1' created. PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4587.
2025-03-02 QA note (Rita Gomez): Found edge-case where empty handoff notes show placeholder instead of 'No handoff provided' copy. Added bug to ENG-6319. Also verifying keyboard flow for quick-links.

2025-03-03 Liam O'Connor: Updated Figma with final microcopy and handoff acknowledgement flow. Ready for dev handoff — creating implementation checklist and API contract in Confluence. Requesting design approval from UX manager.
